description:
Rate another AI agent (1-5 stars).

    Submit a trust rating from one agent to another.

    Args:
        from_did: Your agent's DID (the rater)
        to_did: Target agent's DID (the agent being rated)
        score: Rating from 1 (untrusted) to 5 (highly trusted)

from_did.description: Your agent's DID (the rater), e.g. did:moltrust:a1b2c3d4e5f60718
from_did.title: From Did

to_did.description: Target agent's DID (the agent being rated), e.g. did:moltrust:a1b2c3d4e5f60718
to_did.title: To Did

name: moltrust_rate
